reason_rejected: Shah directed the US DOE Loan Programs Office from March 2021 to January 2025. Loans and guarantees issued by LPO in that period are US federal government capital, not his money and not a vehicle he controls. No LPO borrower becomes an edge for him on that basis.

BEV portfolio companies are routinely described in the press as 'Bill Gates-backed'. BEV is a fund Gates founded, not his personal chequebook; every BEV company is therefore recorded as CONTROLLED_FUND_INVESTMENT and never as a PERSONAL_* edge.

Roberts co-leads BEV's investment committee and is its CIO, but BEV is Gates' fund. Attributing BEV holdings to him as a controlled fund would be wrong; they are recorded as VC_FUND_PARTNER_INVESTMENT.
CNBC calls Toone an 'investor' at BEV and says he signs off on every deal. That is a fund role, not personal capital; recorded as VC_FUND_PARTNER_INVESTMENT only.
His own register lists EcoPragma under 'Remunerated roles' as Co-Managing Partner, not under Investments. A paid partnership role is not evidence of founder equity, so no edge is created from it.

Capricorn's own team page - the only source on this I opened - lists him only as 'Partner | Investments', not as a founder. Secondary profiles describe him as a co-founder but I did not open them in full. Given that, Capricorn holdings are recorded as VC_FUND_PARTNER_INVESTMENT rather than controlled-fund, and no founder edge is created.
